title: AVP - Java Developer - Equity Technology
description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
 Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
   

  

**IT Equities Technology**
 Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real\-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed \& OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front\-office workflows end\-to\-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real\-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting.
   

  

 Operating in a 24x7 follow\-the\-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high\-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C\+\+/C\#, cloud, modern visualization, low\-latency messaging, and in\-memory data stores.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Jefferies’ Equities – Prime Services Technology team is seeking a technically strong and motivated Java Developer to join the Securities Finance technology group in Pune. This role will focus on the design, development, enhancement, and support of strategic trading and servicing systems used by a global Securities Finance user base. You will collaborate closely with cross\-regional technology teams in Hong Kong, London, and New York to build foundational and functional components of the Securities Finance product suite.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and enhance applications and services using Java and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot preferred).
* Design, build, test, deploy, and support core Securities Finance components with a focus on scalability, performance, and resilience.
* Contribute to building distributed systems and enterprise\-grade services (APIs, messaging, batch/stream processing as applicable).
* Work with global teams to deliver features, fixes, and platform improvements across time zones.
* Participate in code reviews, unit/integration testing, and release activities.
* Diagnose production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
* Continuously improve architecture, engineering practices, automation, and observability.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on development experience with Core Java and Spring frameworks.
* Experience delivering distributed systems and enterprise\-grade applications in production.
* Strong knowledge of SQL; experience with Redis and Kafka.
* Familiarity with AWS services such as EKS, EC2, S3, SQS, and SNS.
* Experience with SDLC and tooling including Jira, Bitbucket, and Bamboo.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development; proficiency using GitHub Copilot to improve productivity and code quality.


**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**
* Experience with Python development.
* Familiarity with Airflow, Snowflake, and AWS QuickSight.
* Exposure to financial services, Securities Finance, Prime Services, or trading systems.


**About Us**
 Jefferies is a leading global, full\-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
   

  

 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
   

  

 Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
 You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
   

  

 We’re here to give power to the patient.
   

  

 For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace \- helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
   

  

 Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
 *seeking* 
 to
 *getting* 
 . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
   

  

 Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
   

  

**Your Impact on Our Mission**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Software Engineer** 
 to join the teams that build Zocdoc's provider platform — Provider Infrastructure and Provider Roster Management.
   

  

**These Teams Create And Scale The Core Systems That**
* Store and serve provider, location, and roster data as a reliable source of truth.
* Power onboarding and ongoing management experiences for practices of all sizes, from solo providers to large health systems.
* Ensure provider changes propagate quickly and safely to downstream systems like Search, Availability, Analytics, and Integrations — so patients always see accurate information.


 We're building towards a future where Zocdoc can onboard and manage tens of thousands of providers under a single organization in days, not months, with predictable performance and reliability across the stack. Your work will directly improve how quickly providers get live on Zocdoc, how confidently clients manage their rosters, and how reliably downstream experiences behave as we scale.
   

  

 As a Senior Engineer here, you'll balance meaningful individual contribution with mentorship. You'll work across the stack — front to back and everything in between — with an emphasis on robust, observable services and high\-scale data flows. You'll take ideas from inception to reality by rapidly iterating, validating with real usage, and hardening systems for long\-term scale.
   

  

**You'll Enjoy This Role If You Are…**
* Excited by the challenge of scaling — passionate about building reliable systems with cloud\-native infrastructure and event\-driven patterns.
* A product\-driven engineer who enjoys partnering closely with PM, design, Ops, and analytics to solve real customer problems.
* Motivated by building products that make healthcare easier for providers, operations teams, and patients.
* Excited to use technology to simplify complex workflows — turning messy, high\-volume data into clear, predictable experiences.
* Passionate about building diverse and inclusive teams and culture.
* Curious about how AI and GenAI can responsibly improve developer productivity and provider experiences (e.g., smarter prefill, better insights), while staying grounded in real value.


**Your Day to Day Is…**
* Building and evolving services and tools that power our scaling initiatives across Provider Infrastructure and Roster Management.
* Writing clean, well\-tested code across C\#, React, and AWS\-based services.
* Collaborating closely with engineers, PMs, designers, and Ops to shape solutions from idea to launch.
* Contributing to service migrations away from legacy systems toward modern, event\-driven architectures.
* Using metrics, dashboards, and load tests to keep services healthy and observable as usage grows.
* Sharing knowledge and feedback to help the team move faster and make better technical decisions.


***Note: As a Zocdoc engineer, you'll have access to and be encouraged to use generative AI coding tools as part of your day\-to\-day workflow.***
**You'll Be Successful in This Role If You Have…**
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience, with significant backend or full\-stack work on distributed systems.
* Experience shipping features or services for high\-scale systems — internal tools, data pipelines, or user\-facing applications — where correctness, resilience, and performance matter.
* Comfort working across the stack and learning unfamiliar parts of a system when needed.
* Experience in an agile, cross\-functional environment, collaborating with product, design, analytics, and operations partners.
* A track record of mentoring other engineers and raising the bar on testing, observability, and deployment practices.
* Solid communication skills and empathy for both internal users and external customers.


**Technologies we use**
* C\# and .NET
* React
* AWS — DynamoDB, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Kinesis
* Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, asynchronous event processing
* AI/ML and GenAI tooling (e.g., LLM\-based services, vector search, embeddings, Claude, Cursor, etc)


**Benefits**
* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Flexible, hybrid work environment
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check\-ups
* Sponsored counselling and therapy via Betterlyf
* Competitive PTO
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022\-2026


**About Us**
 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in\-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in\-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last\-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
   

  

 Zocdoc is a mission\-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values \-
 *Together, Not Alone* 
 , we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

**Analyst Expectations**

* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.

* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 At OpenGov bold ideas ship daily and rapid iteration turns directly into measurable customer impact. We stay relentlessly aligned with customer outcomes while pushing the frontier of AI\-driven software development, using cutting\-edge AI tools and techniques to build systems that scale.
   

  

 As a
 **Senior Software Engineer**

As a crucial member of our engineering team, you'll lead and deliver new features and improvements in a fast\-paced, agile environment, utilizing modern technologies such as ReactJS, Typescript, GraphQL, and NodeJS. Strong communication and collaboration skills are essential for maintaining the highest standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate across the organization to understand and translate business priorities into shipped features delivering customer success.
* Generate clean, efficient, and well\-documented software following industry best practices.
* Provide leadership and technical guidance to ensure the development of resilient, scalable SaaS applications.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Troubleshoot, debug and resolve complex technical issues.
* Mentor and guide junior software engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* Contribute to OpenGov’s Engineering culture of innovation, leading\-edge technology adoption and quality
* Cultivate customer empathy to ensure that the solutions exceed customer expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and operational excellence.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, advocating for their adoption where appropriate.


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 9\+ years of experience in developing highly scalable cloud\-native applications with JavaScript/TypeScript, ReactJS, and NodeJS
* Experience building with AI\-driven UX, agents, and workflow automation (direct ML experience not required)
* Deep experience building applications on either Azure or AWS using the latest CI/CD and DevOps best practices
* Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL
* Prior experience in building applications that leverage modern tools like Grafana for observability and performance monitoring
* Proficiency with event\-driven architecture, API integration, and GraphQL is a MUST
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, ambiguous environment.
* Demonstrated experience in working with customers to improve product experiences
* Experience working across the stack (frontend \+ backend) and comfort shipping features end\-to\-end


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

Making conversations around retirement easier and more relevant, offering diversified products, rethinking and improving the end\-to\-end experience for our customers and using technology to effectively engage with them in real time and help them make better decisions about their finances.
   

  

 The journey has started already, are you ready to join us? We need the best digital minds onboard in order to achieve our goal. We are looking for an experienced and innovative AI Engineer to design, build, deploy, and optimise AI\-powered solutions within our regulated financial services environment. The role will be based out of our Engineering Hub in India and working in close collaboration with our UK colleagues across engineering, architecture, data, security, and business teams to deliver scalable AI capabilities that improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, developer productivity, and decision\-making.
   

  

 We promote a supportive, diversified, international environment with an engineering culture we're proud of. We encourage personal growth and invest in open\-minded engineers keen on learning, who continuously try to make things better.

* You have strong software engineering fundamentals in Python (or similar languages) and hands\-on experience building production\-grade AI solutions.
* You want to take a key role on our teams and help us deliver impactful, responsible AI capabilities into a regulated environment.
* You have hands\-on expertise in generative AI – LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* You understand Agile practices like Scrum, Kanban and DevSecOps and have practical experience of at least one.
* You enjoy collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams – product, architecture, data, risk and business – to translate problems into AI solutions.
* You care deeply about security, observability, governance, and responsible AI controls.
* You want to actively engage with our internal AI community of practice on defining standards, frameworks and engineering excellence.
* You love learning and enjoy evaluating emerging AI technologies as well as exploring areas you might not have experience with yet.
* You are versatile when finding solutions and good at explaining complex AI concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* You are proactive and a team player – within your feature team and the wider engineering community – reviewing PRs, mentoring others and collaborating to create the best outcome.


**Accountabilities/Responsibilities**

* System Performance \& Observability: Monitor and optimise the performance, scalability, resilience, and observability of AI\-powered applications, including model monitoring, drift detection and auditability.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for AI solutions, including architecture diagrams, prompt patterns, API documentation and responsible AI controls.
* Compliance, Security \& Responsible AI: Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise governance, security, risk, and regulatory requirements, including data privacy, explainability and operational resilience standards.
* Innovation: Stay updated with the latest generative AI, LLM, and cloud AI advancements to evaluate emerging technologies and recommend appropriate adoption strategies.
* Stakeholder Satisfaction: Ensure high levels of stakeholder satisfaction by delivering AI solutions that meet or exceed business expectations and drive measurable outcomes.


**Responsibilities**
* :AI Solution Engineering: Design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions – including AI\-powered applications, APIs, copilots, agents, and automation workflows – using modern cloud\-native architectures.
* RAG \& Vector Search: Develop and optimise Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, prompt engineering patterns, embeddings, and vector search implementations, and integrate large language models (LLMs) into enterprise applications and engineering workflows.
* Software Engineering \& Platform Delivery: Apply strong engineering principles including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, resilience, and infrastructure\-as\-code; build scalable and secure microservices and data pipelines using modern engineering frameworks.

* Testing \& Evaluation: Develop and execute unit, integration, and model evaluation tests (including offline/online evaluation of LLM outputs) to ensure the reliability and quality of delivered solutions.
* Mentorship \& Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineering teams adopting AI capabilities, and contribute to internal AI communities of practice, engineering standards, and capability development.
* Reusable Frameworks: Contribute to reusable AI frameworks, libraries, prompt and agent patterns, and engineering standards that accelerate adoption across the organisation.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify areas for improvement in the AI delivery lifecycle, recommending and implementing enhancements to optimise efficiency, quality and responsible adoption.

 Product Owners

 Tech Leads

**Permissions \& Compliance Layer**

**Data Quality \& Reliability**

**Documentation \& Standards**

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
 You have 8\+ years of total experience and 4\+ hands\-on experience in data engineering, cloud integrations, or backend development and have shipped production data pipelines on GCP. Specifically:

* Clear written communication: able to document integration contracts and architecture decisions for non\-specialist readers
* Collaborative: comfortable working across DevOps, Network, and Platform teams without friction
* Comfortable with ambiguity — you can scope and deliver integration work from incomplete upstream specs

* Month 6: Owning at least one integration area end\-to\-end; permissions API layer extended with evidence\-backed design decisions
* Month 12: Data integration reliability measurably improved; pipeline documentation and monitoring coverage complete; identified and closed at least one material cost or latency inefficiency

* You are not comfortable working across cloud\-native GCP services in production
* You treat IAM and access control as someone else's concern
* You need fully defined requirements before designing an integration

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a FinOps Engineer with a DevOps backbone who has an almost obsessive eye for cost leaks, idle resources, and inefficiencies across our platform. If unused EBS volumes, oversized instances, or a forgotten dev environment running on weekends genuinely bother you, you'll fit right in. This isn't a passive reporting role. You'll be expected to proactively hunt for waste, propose optimisations, and drive strategic cost conversations with engineering, SRE, and leadership across ZOOP's entire platform from infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters to data pipelines and third\-party services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Continuously audit ZOOP's cloud footprint (AWS/Azure/GCP) end\-to\-end compute, storage, networking, databases, observability stack, and SaaS tooling and flag every form of waste, big or small.
* Proactively propose cost\-reduction strategies rather than waiting to be asked; bring data, options, trade\-offs, and a recommendation to the table.
* Lead monthly/quarterly cost reviews with engineering and product leadership; turn billing data into actionable conversations.
* Build cost visibility dashboards and chargeback/showback models so every team at ZOOP knows what they're spending and why.
* Drive rightsizing, autoscaling tuning, Spot/Reserved Instance/Savings Plan strategies, and storage tiering across the platform.
* Embed cost guardrails into CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and Kubernetes manifests to catch wasteful resources before they're deployed.
* Optimise Kubernetes cost efficiency using tools like Kubecost, OpenCost, or Karpenter; tune requests/limits, HPA/VPA, and node pools.
* Set up automated alerts and anomaly detection for budget breaches, idle resources, and runaway costs.
* Partner with Finance for forecasting, unit economics (cost per user/transaction), and cloud budget planning.
* Evangelise a cost\-aware engineering culture, run internal sessions, write playbooks, and make FinOps a shared responsibility, not a finance afterthought.


**Requirements**
* Someone with genuine OCD around cost and wastage; you can't sleep knowing a non\-prod cluster ran all weekend at full capacity.
* A DevOps practitioner first, who understands why costs happen at the infrastructure level, not just someone reading billing reports.
* Naturally proactive; you don't wait for tickets; you spot patterns, dig in, and propose changes before anyone asks.
* Comfortable challenging engineering decisions diplomatically when they're expensive, and equally comfortable defending necessary spend to finance.
* A clear communicator who can talk to both a senior engineer about Karpenter configs and a CFO about quarterly burn.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, or Cloud FinOps roles.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred), including native cost tools (Cost Explorer, CUR, Azure Cost Management, or GCP Billing).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi).
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE).
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or Go for automation, reporting, and cost tooling.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Solid grasp of cloud pricing models: On\-Demand, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot/Preemptible, committed\-use discounts.
* SQL skills for querying billing data (AWS CUR via Athena/Redshift, BigQuery billing exports).


**Nice To Have**
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with FinOps platforms (CloudHealth, Cloudability/Apptio, Spot.io, Vantage, Kubecost).
* Exposure to multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud cost optimisation.
* Understanding of SaaS unit economics (cost per customer, cost per transaction, gross margin impact).

title: Data Quality Officer
description:
**About The Role**
**As a
 **Data Quality Officer for HR \& Reference Data** 
 , you will be the key enabler in maximizing the value and trustworthiness of our most critical enterprise domains: our workforce information and core reference datasets.**
**You will act as a proactive partner, collaborating closely with business and technical teams. A critical part of your role is bridging perspectives—from HR business partners to IT architects—into clear, actionable data analysis.**
**Your mission is to resolve data issues and nurture a proactive prevention mindset across the organization. You will translate HR processes and Reference Data requirements into formal data quality policies, rules, and governance standards. By storylining data health metrics and serving as a data provocateur when needed, you will drive the continuous improvement of our core data foundation.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Domain\-Specific Insight Generation \& Profiling:
+ Perform deep\-dive root cause analysis on HR datasets (e.g., employee lifecycle, payroll interfaces, org structures) and Reference Data (e.g., enterprise code tables, locations, job classifications, cost centers) to isolate systemic, process, or integration issues.
+ Conduct thorough data profiling on critical master and reference datasets to detect anomalies, cross\-system discrepancies, orphan records, and data drift.
+ Document findings and quantify the business impact of poor data quality on operational HR, compliance, reporting, and downstream integrations.

* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Standard Setting:
+ Work closely with HR Data Stewards, Data Governance, and IT to define, document, and enforce clear data quality rules and reference data standards.
+ Translate HR business rules and Reference Data governance policies into precise technical specifications for automated validation and monitoring tools.
+ Act as the primary liaison between business domain owners and technical teams, ensuring alignment on data lineage and data definitions.

* Monitoring, Reporting \& Governance:
+ Maintain domain\-specific Data Quality Dashboards (e.g., tracking HR data completeness, reference data synchronization) for clear visibility across business units.
+ Track and report HR and Reference Data quality KPIs to leadership, driving transparency and accountability.
+ Support reference data management processes, ensuring code values, mappings, and taxonomies remain synchronized across target applications.

* Remediation \& Prevention:
+ Collaborate with IT and HR Tech teams to define requirements for data cleansing, automated enrichment, and exception management.
+ Support business teams at the point of data entry/creation to improve source data quality and minimize manual workarounds.


****Your Profile****
* Boundary Spanner: Ability to connect HR business processes and enterprise reference data structures with backend technical architectures.
* Influencer \& Storyteller: Skilled at translating complex data anomalies into compelling narratives for HR leadership and business managers.
* Collaborator: A strong team player dedicated to building cross\-functional alignment across HR Operations, Enterprise Data Management/Governance, and IT.
* Mindset: Detail\-oriented, persistent, and proactive about driving data transparency and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, HR Analytics, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Data Quality Officer, Data Governance Analyst, or Data Steward, with direct experience handling HR data, Master Data Management (MDM), or Reference Data domains.
* Essential: Strong proficiency in SQL for complex data querying, profiling, and joining datasets across multi\-table environments.
* Hands\-on experience with modern HR Information Systems (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and Reference Data concepts (code lists, hierarchies, mapping tables).
* Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with global teams.


**Preferred Skills**
* Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks (Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Cataloging).
* Experience using scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automated data checks or profiling is a plus.
* Knowledge of global HR data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, local DPDP regulations).

* Knowledge Management: Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, and training material for vendor onboarding and master data processes; support onboarding of new team members.

* Configure and maintain AI crawler access policies.
* Review and analyze CDN bot traffic logs and recommend adjustments.
* Review AI\-generated content drafts, schema suggestions, and feed enrichment outputs before publishing.

* Monitor and report on AEO/GEO metrics including citation share, AI visibility, traffic, and revenue.
* Support A/B test setup, execution, and result documentation.
* Collaborate with merchandising, content, SEO, and platform engineering teams.

**Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in technical SEO, marketing engineering, or related roles.
* Strong SQL skills; working knowledge of Python.
* Hands\-on experience implementing schema.org and JSON\-LD structured data at scale.
* Experience with PIM systems and product feed management.
* Working knowledge of robots.txt configuration and AI bot access policies.
* Familiarity with CDN bot traffic log analysis.
* Understanding of LLM retrieval and citation mechanisms.
* Experience with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, and analytics platforms.
* Experience with AI\-driven workflow tools such as Airtable.
* Ability to review and QA AI\-generated content and structured data.

* Daily use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.
* Strong documentation and collaboration skills.
* Retail or e\-commerce catalog experience.
* Experience with citation tracking platforms.
* Experience working with multi\-brand portfolios.
* Ability to work with overlap into US Pacific working hours.

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.

* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
